story.who_i_am: I'm the bottom half of Eagle, the Lunar Module that landed the first humans on the Moon.
story.why_sent: My job was to land Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin safely, then serve as a launch pad for their trip home.
story.discoveries: TODO content (samples brought back, seismometer, laser mirror left next to me)
story.where_now: I'm still standing at Tranquility Base. The LRO orbiter has photographed me from above.
